column1: # Duplessis to Cargroy, 19 Jan 1597 (vol. 7, LXVI): letter values. One figure 1-10 per letter, two letters per group.
# The alphabet in order, ten to a round, starting at a = 7: a 7, b 8, c 9, d 10, e 1, f 2 ... (figure = (place + 6) mod 10, 10 for 0).
# status: attested = occurs in a passage that reads exactly; inferred = place in the alphabet only
